c01q.actionNow: Get written confirmation that the as-built height matches the approved plans before the OC inspection
c01q.risk: Building height only assumed acceptable to the client and BMC (architect note 1 on every plan: "We are assuming building height is okay for client & municipal authority")
c01q.warningSign: Any query on height during OC scrutiny

c01r.actionNow: Confirm the extension is covered by the approved plans before the OC inspection
c01r.risk: Amenity area raised from 2% to 4% and slabs extended; the architect asked for comments (1st floor plan)
c01r.warningSign: Extended slabs not shown in the latest approved (amended) plans

c01s.actionNow: Confirm passage A is approved or regularised; keep the approval letter ready
c01s.risk: OC note: the building matches the approved drawing except the additional passage marked A on the 1st floor
c01s.warningSign: BMC objects to passage A at OC scrutiny

c01t.actionNow: Ask SBP to renumber; until then quote number AND title
c01t.risk: Same drawing numbers used for different sheets (WL/FP/124, 125, 126): the wrong sheet can be used on site
c01t.warningSign: Site refers to a drawing by number only

c900.actionNow: Obtain the MahaRERA certificate and the latest quarterly progress report, and enter the verified dates
c900.risk: Public sources disagree on key project facts: completion 30-Dec-2028 vs possession Dec-2027, Jun-2028, Dec-2028 or Apr-2029; 10, 11, 13 or 36 units; 20 floors vs 43 sanctioned floors; RERA registration 8-Sep-2021 vs 18-Mar-2020
c900.warningSign: Any date or unit count used in the app that is not from the MahaRERA certificate
